messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] Re: natmanager installation issue (not on CRAN)
messages.subject_clean: [nat-user] Re: natmanager installation issue (not on CRAN)
messages.body_plain:
Hi Dr. Jefferis and Arthur,

Thank you for the replies. I have installed the packages from Github.

Best,
Liangyu Tao

On Wednesday, June 22, 2022 at 7:48:26 PM UTC-4 jeff...@gmail.com wrote:
> Dear Liangyu,
>
> Many thanks for the message. I had not realised that natmanager had been archived because the package maintainer is a former group member. It looks like the problem is a test failing due to GitHub limiting requests from the CRAN build machine. I’ll try to see if I can adopt the package and get it back on cran. In the meantime you can install from GitHub.
>
>  All the best,
>
> Greg.
>
> Sent from my iPhone
>
> > On 22 Jun 2022, at 23:42, artx...@gmail.com <artx...@gmail.com> wrote:
> >
> > ﻿Hi Liangyu,
> >
> > just to confirm that i see the same error when calling
> > install.packages("natmanager")
> >
> > maybe something went wrong when they exported a new version of package. Greg and his team would know this.
> >
> > For the record, if you need a package from natverse asap, you could try to install the package alone, for example
> > https://natverse.org/nat/
> >
> > best,
> > arthur
> >
> > On Friday, June 17, 2022 at 3:48:09 PM UTC-4 liangyu...@gmail.com wrote:
> > > Hi Dr. Jefferis,
> > >
> > > I am trying to install natmanager to a windows computer today and found that it is no longer hosted on CRAN.
> > > When I try calling install.packages("natmanager"), it says:
> > > Installing package into ‘C:/Users/lt532/Documents/R/win-library/4.1’
> > > (as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
> > > Warning in install.packages :
> > >   package ‘natmanager’ is not available for this version of R
> > > A version of this package for your version of R might be available elsewhere,
> > > see the ideas at
> > > https://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-patched/R-admin.html#Installing-packages
> > >
> > > I double checked the CRAN website and it said:
> > > Package ‘natmanager’ was removed from the CRAN repository.
> > > Formerly available versions can be obtained from the archive.
> > > Archived on 2022-06-11 as check issues were not corrected in time.
> > >
> > > I then tried installing from source but could not get it to work both through Rstudio and running R as an administrator. The folder shows up in the library path for my R version, but does not show up when I check for packages by calling:
> > > installed.packages()
> > >
> > > Not sure if it matters, but I'm using R version 4.1.1 and the newest version of RStudio.
> > > I would like some help to continue with the installation.
> > >
> > > Best,
> > > Liangyu Tao
> > >
> > --
